guest_image.base: same signed Alpine ISO as vm/image-lock.json

notes: Pinned public vendor artifacts only. tar_sha512 is the registry/base64 form the lane verifier consumes; tar_sha512_hex_from_package_manager is the identical digest in the hex encoding baum-os commits in package.json packageManager (equality enforced by baum_prep.verify). pnpm 11 ships ESM: the bin wrapper imports ../dist/pnpm.mjs relatively, so the guest keeps the bin/dist layout. bash, git and the git-core helper directory come from dpkg-verified host files exactly like the node libraries. The offline dependency store is built from the pinned baum-os lockfile with lifecycle scripts disabled on the host; package scripts run only inside the qualified VM.
